summary.name: ElectroCRUD
summary.one_liner: ElectroCRUD is an open-source desktop app (built on Electron) for creating database admin panels and dashboards to perform CRUD operations without writing code.
use_cases: Manage database records without writing code
Build a custom database admin panel or dashboard
Document tables and columns for a database
Tag columns and set policies for sensitive data
Browse and edit MySQL, SQLite, PostgreSQL or SQL Server data
summary.what_it_does: ElectroCRUD lets users perform create, read, update and delete operations on databases through a user-friendly interface, without coding. It can be used to build personalized database admin panels or dashboards. The v3 release, rebuilt in React and TypeScript, adds table and column-level documentation, column tagging, and policies for handling sensitive data. It supports MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server. The project is described as free and open source.
notable: Rebuilt v3 in React and TypeScript with table and column documentation and tagging
Sensitive-data policies for tables and columns
Supports MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server
Originally built in 2016 as an Electron app; listed under Databases in awesome-mac
caveats: Platform support is not stated on the page beyond it being an Electron-based application
Page is largely marketing text; specific setup steps and version details are not given
